description: BMAD module that drives the full BMAD story workflow end-to-end — one story at a time, or a whole epic in one run — on Claude Code, Codex, or opencode.

plugins.name: auto-bmad
plugins.description: Drive the full BMAD story workflow (create-story -> dev-story -> code-review, plus risk-gated TEA + epic-boundary skills) for one story at a time — or an ENTIRE epic in one run (`/auto-bmad epic`): one branch, commit per step, open a PR, and report. The orchestrator only delegates to model/effort-tuned subagents, with a graceful fallback to general subagents or inline execution on tools that lack them.
